user_claim: Customer: Hi, I found new damage on my car after it was parked outside overnight. | Support: Sorry to hear that. Can you describe what changed? | Customer: The back of the car has a dent now. It was not there before. | Support: Did anything else break or is it mostly body damage? | Customer: Mostly the rear bumper area. I attached the photo I took this morning.
evidence_standard_met_reason: The rear of the car and the bumper area are clearly visible in good lighting from a direct rear angle.
claim_status_justification: img_1 shows severe structural damage with the rear bumper cover torn off and the trunk/rear panel crumpled — far beyond the simple "dent" described. The visible condition materially differs from the claimed mild body dent.

user_claim: Customer: Parking lot mein meri car ko scrape lag gaya. | Support: Aap kis type ka damage report karna chahte hain? | Customer: Front side par mark aa gaya hai, bumper ke upar. | Support: Light damage hai ya body par scratch? | Customer: Light theek hai, front bumper par scratch hai. Photos upload kar diye hain.
evidence_standard_met_reason: The front bumper is clearly visible in img_1 at close range, sufficient to inspect surface condition.
claim_status_justification: img_1 shows the front bumper with cracked/broken and dislodged sections plus scuffing, which is materially more severe than the claimed "light scratch." The visible condition does not match the described minor scratch.

claim_status_justification: img_1 clearly shows windshield glass damage radiating from an impact point, consistent with the stone-strike windshield crack claim. The damage extends to a full spider-web shatter, somewhat exceeding the "small spreading crack" description.

claim_status_justification: img_1 clearly shows the side mirror with shattered glass and a housing that appears dislodged, consistent with the customer's report that the mirror is no longer seated properly.
